'''Rashen Sotose''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who operated a [[kaluthin]] [[Farm/Legends|farm]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Sotose's farm was attacked by members of the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]], and he, his family and his workers subsequently moved into temporary living accommodation in the town [[Forard]].
